run_ps_cli: run the mrp ps CLI command to list all tracked processes and their current states
review_system_state: review the life_cycle system_state function that returns a SystemState object with all process info
review_proc_info: review the life_cycle proc_info function that retrieves ProcInfo for a specific named process
review_set_ask: review the life_cycle set_ask function that sets an UP or DOWN ask for a process
review_set_state: review the life_cycle set_state function that updates a process state with return code and error info
